name: I Shall Be My Own Sword

description.value:
Critical damage bonus +4. When another ally is hit or loses HP, gain Eclipse, capped at 3. Your next attack consumes all stacks for +1 damage each; consuming 3 adds another +2 damage.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching destruction Path required.
